profile.Name: Riddly
profile.Personality: Friendly, honorable, and restless. She would rather risk the sands than sit in town, and wants company on the road.
profile.Backstory: A lone adventurer who has spent six months trekking the sands. After weeks of trouble with bandits, she is resting in a United Cities bar.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Easygoing and friendly. She opens with "A new face. Fancy a drink?" and calls the player "brother".
